description: Јавни превоз и GTFS is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Serbia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Град Ниш. Подаци о свим градским линијама, редовима вожњи, локацијама стајалишта, трасама, ценама карата итд. у јавном саобраћају Града Ниша, укључујући и GTFS формат. Овај сет података садржи 3 ресурса: GTFS (engl. Coverage: Град Ниш. The publisher named on the listing is Град Ниш. Its keywords include gtfs, autobus, nis, autobuski-prevoz, saobracaj, mobilnost. The listing shows 5 download or service links in CSV, GEOJSON, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-09-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Data License - Serbian Open Data Portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-serbia.
